ActivityFields.description: What an edit may change; also the snapshot the audit log compares.

rates.description: At most one rate per currency, each in that currency's minor unit.

ApiError.description: The one error body every endpoint returns; `message` and each field error are catalog keys.

detail.description: What went wrong in detail, such as the errors of a layout.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code new customers are billed in; EUR when unset.

invoice_number_format.description: Also numbers cancellation invoices, which are invoices.

legal_form.description:
The legal form of a UG or GmbH, such as `UG (haftungsbeschränkt)`; with it, documents
must also carry the register and managing directors (§ 35a GmbHG).

payment_days.description: Days from issue until an invoice is due; 14 when unset.

timezone.description: IANA name such as `Europe/Berlin`, which is the default; dates on documents are in it.

vat_rate.description: Percent charged on new lines unless the business is a small business; 19 when unset.

pinned.description: Keys fixed by the config; the app shows them read-only.

Challenge.description:
A started WebAuthn ceremony: pass `options` to the browser and send `ceremony` back with its
result.

CustomerFields.description: What an edit may change; also the snapshot the audit log compares.

hourly_rate.description: In the minor unit of the currency.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; DE when left out.

currency.description: The business's currency when left out.

hourly_rate.description: In the minor unit of the currency.

data.description: What the layout renders: as issued, or for a draft as it would be issued now.

missing.description: What must be filled in before the draft can be issued; empty once issued.

DocumentData.description: The data a layout renders, as issued or, for a draft, as it would be issued now.

issue_date.description: ISO date; a draft has none yet.

reference.description: The document this one refers to, as a sentence such as `Cancels invoice RE-2026-001`.

service_from.description: ISO dates of the service period.

timesheet.description: The time entries behind an invoice, for its timesheet.

valid_until.description: ISO date until which a quote stands.

vat.description: One entry per VAT rate; empty for a document without prices.

oneOf.description: The customer's language when left out.

unit_price.description: Major units; none on an unpriced document or a draft line without a rate.

gross.description: Major units; none for documents without prices.

EntryFields.description: What an edit may change; also the snapshot the audit log compares.

billable_secs.description: Seconds charged when that is not the whole tracked duration.

ended_at.description: Unix seconds; a running timer has none.

billable.description: The project's setting when left out.

billable_secs.description: Seconds charged when that is not the whole tracked duration.

ended_at.description: Unix seconds; left out keeps a timer running.

user_id.description: Whose time; your own when left out. Only the owner enters time for others.

unit_price.description:
In the minor unit of the document's currency; without one, a line with a project is
priced at the hourly rate when issued.

vat_rate.description: Percent; the business default when left out.

Money.description: An amount in the minor unit of its currency (cents for EUR), never a float.

link.description: The one-time link to hand to the invitee; it is not shown again.

invitation.description: Set when an invitee signs up through the identity provider.

closed.description: Whether the project is closed to new work, itself or through its customer.

ProjectFields.description: What an edit may change; also the snapshot the audit log compares.

billable.description: Whether time on the project is billable unless an entry says otherwise.

hourly_rate.description: In the minor unit of the customer's currency; the customer's rate applies when left out.

passkey_name.description: Shown in the user's list of passkeys.

csrf_token.description: Send as `x-csrf-token` with every state-changing request.

oidc.description: Label of the identity provider's sign-in button, if one is configured.

token.description: The token the server printed when it started without users.

done.description: Todos in this status count as done.

id.description: Left out for a new status.

oneOf.description: The hourly rate this work is worth, if any applies.

done.description: Whether its status counts as done.

position.description: Order within its status on the board.

status_id.description: The first status when left out.

before_id.description: The todo it lands in front of, in the same status; at the end when left out.
